_about: Which official feeds the election-night worker reads. A state is read only when its 'election' is filled in (the id/date/code the state uses for the Nov. 3, 2026 general election; it appears when the state publishes its results page). Sources for every state: docs/results-sources.md. Reader status for every state: docs/reader-status.md. Readers: alaska (CSV by precinct), north_carolina (ZIP), minnesota (text files; election = date like 20261103), clarity (election = the id in the Clarity address, e.g. 122598), enhanced_voting (Georgia verified; Utah/Washington/Idaho untested).

AK.note: 26GENR is the usual code; verified once the state publishes. Alaska needs data/config/extra_ca.pem (missing certificate on their server).

GA.note: auto = look up the Nov. 3, 2026 election id from the state's list (11032026GeneralAndSpecialElection)

SC.note: Clarity at enr-scvotes.org/SC/; same format as Colorado, not yet tested on SC

KY.note: Clarity believed; the probe got a 403, so may need hand entry

AR.note: Arkansas moved to a new site; check on election day

ID.note: id from voteidaho.gov; unconfirmed platform; same platform as Georgia, address pattern untested

IN.note: Indiana's own results app files (U.S. House); live since 6 p.m. Nov. 3
